g.text: ISV NEMESIS — DECK 03 // MISSION FLOW OVERLAY
ANNOTATED BEATS • GATES & KEYS • ROUTES • SPAWN ZONES • EXTRACTION — DESIGN DOC v1.5 COMPANION
BOARD — breach hull (stealth window until first contact)
SLICE — CIC security override (20 s hack, defend the slicer)
VENT — coolant at Life Support (within 30 s of 2A)
ARM & HOLD — reactor demo charge (90 s hold-out)
EXTRACT — forward docking collar (150 s, ship in meltdown)
Key run — CIC to Life Support
Blast gate — opens with both keys
DESIGN RULE — no straight lines: every key lives in a different section than its lock; the extraction point differs from the entry. The way out is never the way in.
